$comment: CarSetup keys excluded from setup identity (values fingerprint). Derived by the sim or run readings, not user settings. Source: prove/P5 (corner weights, ride heights, ARB and truck-arm preload differ by 1 N / 1 mm / 0.2 Nm for the same file) and setup_recordings.py:30-33 (run readings). Patterns match the last path segment of a CarSetup key such as Chassis.LeftFront.CornerWeight, case-insensitively. Values are still stored and shown; they only do not count toward identity. Change by contract review only.

fingerprint.input: for each remaining key in ascending UTF-8 byte order: key + 0x1F + raw value string exactly as published (trimmed) + 0x1E
